notes: Supplemental wages over $1,000,000 in the year are withheld at a mandatory 37%, regardless of Form W-4.
Social Security stops once wages for the year reach $184,500; the line shows what this payment adds to the year's total.
California's flat rate for bonuses and stock options; other supplemental pay (overtime, commissions, severance, vacation) uses 6.6%.
California liability excludes the phase-out of exemption credits at higher incomes (not modeled).
Local income taxes (city, county, school district) are not included.
Withholding is a prepayment: the difference between the lines' liability and withholding is settled on the federal and state returns.
